content: We have combined subnetworks with resistors R1,R2,R3 from subnet1 and R4,R5,R6,R7 from subnet2. Simulations match measurements: A-B 66.363 vs 66.364 (close), A-N_b1 21.363 vs 21.364, A-N_b2 31.363 vs 31.364, A-N_b3 46.363 vs 46.364, A-X1 16.363 vs 16.364. Also internal measurements of subnet2: B-N_b1 45 matches, B-N_b2 35 vs simulated? Let's simulate B to N_b2: need topology. Use simulate.
